B Deeds and Documents: Will-Construing of-Wife bequeathing self acquired property to her husband and after his death to her three minor nephews as the couple had no C issue-It was specifically mentioned that after the death of husband, his relations would have no right to the estate-After death of possession of the property and filed an injunction suit which ended in compromise between the plaintiffs and father of the minors-later the three D nephews of the testator claiming their right through will filed another suit stating that the compromise was obtained by undue influence, coercion
Decision Date : 08-04-2003 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9961/1995 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
